title: Parametric open CAD: RAS receiver envelope and interface
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. The receiver's external envelope and tongue interface define what seat designers must accommodate. Depends on: ridebelt-cad-001 (do those first or use their outputs if merged). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Model the receiver envelope, mounting pattern, drain slot, indicator window and tongue interface (internals simplified), using the same tool and parameters as cad-001.
acceptanceCriteria: Mates with the cad-001 tongue in an assembly
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
